name: Ksemaraja (Rajanaka Ksemaraja)
summary: Pupil of Abhinavagupta; systematiser for students (PHrdaya, 20 sutras). Commentator across Agama, Spanda and Pratyabhijna for the nondual reading.
bio: Pupil of Abhinavagupta; systematiser for students: the Pratyabhijnahrdaya digests Pratyabhijna in 20 sutras. Commentator across all three sastras — Agama (Svacchanda/Netra/Vijnanabhairava Uddyotas, Sivasutravimarsini), Spanda (Sandoha on K1, Nirnaya whole at pupil Sura's request), Pratyabhijna (Stavacintamani-tika) — arguing the nondual reading against rivals. Life and parentage otherwise unknown.
